headline: Ukraine used homemade drone relay network to bypass Starlink in bridge strike
summary: Ukrainian forces used a homemade network of relay drones, described as "flying modems," instead of Starlink during a strike on the Crimean Bridge. The setup let them keep a live feed of the attack even as Russia tried to jam the signal, and drew on tactics adapted from battlefield lessons learned from Russia.
